content.short: Lenster is a composable, decentralized, permissionless social media app built with Lens Protocol.
content.description: Lenster is a composable, decentralized, permissionless social media web app built on Lens Protocol. It provides a full-featured way to interact with your social graph and supports a variety of NFT types to enrich posts and profiles across networks. The interface mirrors a familiar microblogging layout, while remaining open to extensibility for developers and communities. Lenster emphasizes user control, interoperability, and openness in Web3, delivering a robust, community-driven social experience.
